_about.units: times ns, exposures photon ns (int nbar dt), omega = g/sqrt2

convergence_80_vs_90.check: nbar_C, V_C, c and b agree between cutoffs 80 and 90 to the quoted digits

nbar_avg_exact_maxdev.check: 1/2 Tr(U Pi U^dag n) - nbar_C along T*, full space

nbar_SIcardinal_avg_maxdev.check: six SI cardinal states (non-orthogonal |0_L>,|1_L>), not an exact design: deviation O(c|b|)

haar_mc.check: Monte Carlo mean of 20000 Haar inputs within sampling error of nbar_C

exposure_analytic_vs_numeric_maxdiff.check: E(r0) = nbar_C T* + w.r0 against Simpson on 2001 points

var_octa_avg_maxdev.check: octahedron (2-design) average of Var n = V_C

var_basis_avg_range.check: average of Var n over one orthonormal basis is not invariant (needs a 2-design)

full_space_with_complement_hamiltonian.check: an arbitrary Hamiltonian on the complement of C changes no cost on C

summary.check: every flip that keeps the qubit encoded: E_avg = nbar_C T, T >= T*, end map X_L exp(-i phi Z_L/2)

vacuum_transfer.check: matches Supplementary Table route (397 ns, 359, 965, 662, F=0.599)

transfer_0L_to_1L_within_C.check: minimize int (nbar_C + b.r) dvartheta over curves on the Bloch sphere of C, 160 segments, L-BFGS-B, 8 starts

transfer_0L_to_1L_smooth.check: 12 sine modes of off-plane deformation, Hessian by central differences, BFGS from 24 random starts (|y| up to ~90 deg)

discrete_optimum_resampled.check: the best discrete path, resampled, is not below the great circle

generic_input.check: per input the gate path is neither the input's time optimum nor its photon optimum, and within C the two single-input optima differ only when b has a component normal to the input's great circle

transfer_1L_within_C.check: per input the gate path within C is not the photon optimum: |1_L> would rather pass the side with fewer photons

lindblad_equal_duration.check: three flips of equal duration that keep the qubit encoded: equal averaged Lindblad error, oscillator part only
